no_sign_activities: hand resting then moving near chest
unknown_sign_policy: A fluent independent reviewer chooses three distinct glosses absent from the installed ASL-2000 plus starter vocabulary before predictions are inspected.
capture_instruction: One continuous original take, at most 30 seconds and 100 MB. Keep the face, torso and signing hands in view. Include a short natural lead-in and ending; do not add, duplicate, crop or mirror frames. Sign naturally with the usual dominant hand. Record actual device and hand use.
privacy: Store media and intake/review records under ignored evaluation/videos/ and evaluation/raw/. Public manifests contain pseudonyms and private-record references, never names or consent forms.
split: development only; recruit separately from all reserved holdout participants
release_claim: Development collection targets, not observed trials, a statistical power calculation, or release acceptance thresholds.
